name: pimcore-toolkit
description: Version-aware Pimcore engineering toolkit for Pimcore 10, 11, 12, the 2025.4 LTS and 2026 with Pimcore Studio. /pimcore routes development work (analysis, architecture, data modelling, implementation, debugging, integrations, testing, review, upgrades) to the right specialist. /pimcore-setup builds a working Pimcore environment on Linux, macOS, Windows and WSL2, Docker first.
